text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After shopping for supplies, Shinko<n>Windy and I are
on our way home<n>when a young boy runs up to us.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's Windy! Can I shake your<n>hand?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who's this little runt?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: I wanna become a big bad like you,<n>Windy!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
It was so cool when you said, "Being<n>evil means
only doing the stuff you<n>wanna do!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Hahaha! I like ya, kid, so I'll tell<n>ya what. I'm
gonna make you one of<n>my lackeys!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! Does that mean we're<n>gonna beat the
good guys? The bad<n>guys always lose, but you're
different from a normal villain, right?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Just leave it to your big<n>bad boss! I'll
show ya how to not<n>lose a fight!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... How can I show him a<n>diabolically evil
triumph?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you seem rather troubled, my dear<n>friend! I'd be
happy to lend an ear to<n>your dilemma.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh, Pearl! Or I should say—Deadly<n>Enchantress!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...And that's why we gotta beat the<n>allies of
justice! I wanna show my<n>new lackey how wicked
cool I am!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a great goal, Windy! But<n>are you certain
that merely winning is<n>enough?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? Whaddya mean?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Is a victory for evil all you need to<n>achieve? I
wonder if that will satisfy<n>your lackey.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: He isn't just a fan of any oldevil—he's a fan of you, correct?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So you're sayin' I needa think 'bout<n>what my
lackey really wants to see...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
It was so cool when you said, "Being<n>evil means
only doing the stuff you<n>wanna do!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec! I get it now!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, looks like you've caught on,<n>Windy. Now go
show him what his big<n>boss is made of!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah! But I'll need your help too,<n>Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: On our next day off, let's stage a<n>show of villainy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Shinko Windy<n>invites her new
lackey to a stage<n>performance. She's playing the
evil<n>lord, while I've been cast as a hero<n>of justice.
choice_data_list: Stop right there, Demon Lord Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So you finally show yourself, Justice<n>Mask! It's
time for me to defeat you<n>once and for all!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Please leave this weakling<n>to me, my lord!
You need not dirty<n>your hands with this one!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ghh! B-but why?! Why spare one of<n>the Demon
Lord's senior officers?!
choice_data_list: It's not too late to mend your ways!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If my sins can be forgiven... then I'll<n>start my life
over!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Lord Windy! Please join me, and<n>let's turn over a
new lea—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: NEVER!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Betray me if you wish! ...However!<n>The sinister
heart of a true villain will<n>never be swayed!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even if I must stand alone! No matter<n>what anyone
else says! I'll live how I<n>choose to, right until the
very end!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That is what it means to be evil! I<n>shall never yield
to the heroes of<n>justice!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: D-don't give in, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Watch closely, lackey! This is<n>the true
power of Demon Lord Windy!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! You did it! Evil won! That<n>was so cool the
way you never gave<n>up, Boss! You kept fighting
even<n>though you were all alone!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gahaha! Isn't evil just the coolest?!<n>Praise and
idolize me more!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And, Trainer. That was a pretty good<n>job out there.
Thanks to you, the<n>show went off without a hitch.
choice_data_list: It's great you've found another loyal lackey!
It's great you've found another loyal lackey!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And, Trainer. That was a pretty good<n>job out there.
Thanks to you, the<n>show went off without a hitch.
choice_data_list: It's great you've found another loyal lackey!
It's great you've found another loyal lackey!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Whatcha yappin' about?! A<n>boss is
supposed to work hard for<n>her lackeys!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing good about it! Evil<n>people only do
bad things!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy successfully shows<n>her new lackey
how cool she really<n>is. He's sure to keep cheering
for her<n>in the future.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh heh! Yeah, I guess I did!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
He's got a lot of promise too! One<n>day, he might
even become as evil as<n>me! Mwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy showed what it takes<n>to live a life of
evil. I'm certain her<n>lackey has learned the
importance of<n>staying true to what one believes in.
